purpose: Complete LoRA comparator: prediction audit, exploratory paired OOD comparisons, representation diagnostics, and hardware-matched computation probes.
selection: All 45 candidate training runs and 15 source selections before M5 tests; diagnostics never revise selection.
statistics: 18 M5-minus-existing-method OOD contrasts (6 methods x 3 budgets); separate exploratory Holm family; original M6 focal family unchanged. Five paired seeds, unadjusted t intervals and exact sign flips; no claim of confirmatory preregistration.
cka: 15 M5 winners, same 256 balanced inputs/domain and C-v2 frozen extractor/estimators; 1170 rows, 45 prediction replays; 45 expected degenerate layer-0 CLS rows. Pretrained reference only. Cross-hardware deterministic numerical variation disclosed.
cost: Same Ada hardware, six existing clean methods and M5 x three fresh processes; shared C-v2 kernel/input IDs/FP32/noTF32/512/batch8/accum4/warmup2/measured5. M4 is phase2 proxy. Training-cost only for cross-method LoRA comparison; unmerged M5 inference excluded from deployment claims.
